metadata.repo_type_justification: Application source code (Ruby) with a Rails controller entry point and MySQL database backend. Single-service e-commerce storefront.
metadata.archetype_justification: MySQL database with CRUD operations on orders (create, show, index), entity lifecycle management with payment processing side effects.

findings.title: No Documented API Interface
findings.description: The application exposes a Rails 2.3 controller with implicit routes (index, create, show) but has no documented API interface. Integration requires reverse-engineering controller code.
findings.gap: No API documentation. Endpoints discoverable only via code inspection.
findings.recommendation: Document existing controller endpoints as an OpenAPI 3.0 specification. Add explicit REST API layer with versioned routes.

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, Swagger, AsyncAPI, GraphQL schema, or Smithy model exists. The API surface is defined only implicitly through Rails controller code.
findings.gap: No machine-readable spec. Agent tool definitions require manual authoring from code inspection.
findings.recommendation: Create an OpenAPI 3.0 specification documenting orders endpoints, request/response schemas, and error codes.

findings.title: No Structured Error Responses
findings.description: Errors render HTML forms. No JSON error bodies, no error codes, no retryable indicators. Agents cannot distinguish retriable from terminal errors.
findings.gap: No structured error response format for machine consumption.
findings.recommendation: Implement consistent JSON error format with error code, message, and retryable boolean across all endpoints.

findings.title: No Idempotent Write Operations
findings.description: POST /orders has no idempotency key support. Retries create duplicate orders and trigger duplicate payment charges to the SOAP gateway.
findings.gap: No idempotency mechanism on write endpoints. Duplicate requests create duplicate records and charges.
findings.recommendation: Add idempotency key parameter with server-side deduplication and unique constraint enforcement.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no idempotency controls on write endpoints.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The create action saves an order and charges a payment card with no deduplication. Agent retries would create duplicate orders and duplicate charges.

findings.title: HTML-Only Response Format
findings.description: Rails 2.3 application renders HTML views by default. No JSON serialization configured. API surface serves HTML, not machine-readable structured data.
findings.gap: Responses are HTML, not machine-readable structured data suitable for agent consumption.
findings.recommendation: Add respond_to blocks with JSON format support, or create dedicated API namespace with JSON-only controllers.

findings.title: No Asynchronous Operation Support
findings.description: Payment SOAP call is synchronous within the HTTP request cycle. No background jobs, no async/polling pattern, no job status API.
findings.gap: Long-running payment operations block HTTP requests with no async alternative.
findings.recommendation: Move payment processing to async workflow with job status polling endpoint.

findings.title: No Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: No event emission capability. No webhooks, no SNS/EventBridge/SQS integration, no CDC pipelines.
findings.gap: State changes (order creation, payment charge) are not observable by external systems.
findings.recommendation: Add event emission (SNS or EventBridge) for order state changes.

findings.title: No Rate Limit Documentation or Headers
findings.description: No rate limits documented. No X-RateLimit-Remaining headers, no Retry-After headers in responses.
findings.gap: Agents cannot self-throttle based on rate limit feedback.
findings.recommendation: Expose rate limit headers when server-side rate limiting is implemented.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: No authentication mechanism exists. Comment explicitly states missing before_filter for auth. Any caller can access any endpoint without identification.
findings.gap: Complete absence of authentication. No machine identity, no principal attribution.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 client credentials flow or API key authentication with per-caller principal attribution.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions
findings.description: No authorization model exists. All callers have identical unrestricted access to all endpoints and data.
findings.gap: No permission scoping mechanism. Cannot differentiate access levels.
findings.recommendation: Implement RBAC with scoped roles for agent callers after establishing authentication.

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization. Any caller can perform any action (read, create, charge payment).
findings.gap: Cannot restrict agent to read-only access within the same resource type.
findings.recommendation: Implement fine-grained RBAC with action-level permissions.

findings.title: No Identity Propagation
findings.description: No identity propagation. No JWT parsing, no OAuth2 token exchange, no on-behalf-of flows.
findings.gap: Cannot distinguish agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.recommendation: Implement JWT-based identity propagation after establishing machine identity.

findings.title: Credentials in Source Control
findings.description: Live payment gateway credentials (merchant_id, api_password) stored in plaintext in version-controlled config/payment.yml.
findings.gap: Credentials in source control. No secrets management. No rotation capability.
findings.recommendation: Rotate credentials immediately. Migrate to AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation.

findings.title: No Immutable Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging of any kind. Write operations (order creation, payment charges) not logged with caller identity. No CloudTrail, no immutable log storage.
findings.gap: Complete absence of audit logging and immutable log storage.
findings.recommendation: Implement audit logging with CloudTrail and S3 Object Lock for immutable storage.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no audit logging exists.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write operations (order creation, payment charging) have no audit trail. Cannot prove compliance or conduct forensics for agent-initiated actions.

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension
findings.description: No identity management exists. No mechanism to suspend or revoke agent access without full application shutdown.
findings.gap: Cannot isolate misbehaving agent without taking down entire application.
findings.recommendation: Implement API key-based auth with immediate revocation capability.

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback
findings.description: Multi-step create+charge workflow has no compensation logic. Failed payment after order save leaves orphaned database record with no reversal mechanism.
findings.gap: No compensation or rollback for multi-step write operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement saga pattern with compensation logic for order-create-then-charge workflow.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no compensation exists for multi-step write workflows.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The create action saves an order then charges payment. If charge fails, the order remains with no rollback. Agent-initiated workflows would leave inconsistent state.

findings.title: SQL-Injection Vulnerable Query Interface
findings.description: Index action queries by status via SQL injection-vulnerable code. Show returns individual order. Query interface is rudimentary and unsafe.
findings.gap: Query interface uses direct string interpolation in SQL. Unsafe for agent consumption.
findings.recommendation: Replace SQL injection-vulnerable query with parameterized queries. Add safe filter and pagination.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No optimistic locking, no version fields, no ETags, no conditional writes. Concurrent agent instances could cause race conditions.
findings.gap: No concurrency controls. Concurrent agent writes could corrupt state.
findings.recommendation: Add optimistic locking (version column) and idempotency keys.

findings.title: No Circuit Breakers for External Dependencies
findings.description: External SOAP payment gateway call has no circuit breaker, no retry logic, no timeout configuration. Gateway failures cascade to all callers.
findings.gap: No resilience patterns for external dependency calls.
findings.recommendation: Implement circuit breaker with configurable timeout, retry with exponential backoff, and fallback behavior.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting
findings.description: No rate limiting at any layer. No API Gateway, no WAF rate rules, no application middleware. Mongrel behind Apache with no throttling.
findings.gap: Runaway agent loops can overwhelm the application and downstream payment gateway.
findings.recommendation: Deploy API Gateway with per-caller throttling configuration.

findings.title: No Blast Radius or Transaction Limits
findings.description: No transaction limits. No per-caller caps, no maximum spend limits, no bulk operation size constraints. Agent error could trigger unlimited payment charges.
findings.gap: No blast radius caps. Unbounded agent-initiated operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-caller transaction limits (max orders/hour, max charge/session).

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State
findings.description: No draft or pending state. Orders immediately committed and payment charged in single request with no intermediate review.
findings.gap: No reviewable intermediate state for agent-proposed writes.
findings.recommendation: Add PENDING status to order lifecycle before payment processing.

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No approval gates. All operations execute immediately without oversight. Cannot require human confirmation for high-risk operations.
findings.gap: No configurable approval gates for high-risk agent-initiated operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable approval gates by operation type and amount threshold.

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No staging environment documented. Payment gateway configured for live mode only. No docker-compose, no seed data.
findings.gap: No safe environment to test agent behavior. First bug discovery in production.
findings.recommendation: Create staging environment with payment test mode and seed data.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Exposed in API Responses
findings.description: Stage A: System processes PCI-regulated credit card data (card_number, card_exp). Stage B: B1 fires — Order.find returns all fields including card data with no filtering. B2 fires — no access differentiation exists.
findings.gap: B1: Card data exposed in API responses. B2: No access control differentiation. B3: No classification metadata.
findings.recommendation: Add field filtering to exclude card_number/card_exp from API responses. Implement tokenized card storage.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND sensitive data (credit card numbers) exposed unfiltered in API responses.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Order.find returns all fields including card_number and card_exp. Agent-facing APIs expose raw credit card data.

b1.reasoning: Order.find(params[:id]) returns all fields including card_number, card_exp with no exclusion. Write-enabled scope.

b2.reasoning: No access control differentiation — all callers see all fields including sensitive data.

b3.reasoning: No formal classification metadata, tags, or PII detection tooling.

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls for PCI Data
findings.description: PCI-regulated payment card data stored in MySQL on EC2 with no residency controls, no region constraints, no data sovereignty policies.
findings.gap: No data residency policies for PCI data. No controls preventing cross-jurisdiction data transmission.
findings.recommendation: Implement region-locked storage with data sovereignty policies. Prevent card data from reaching LLM providers.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND PCI-regulated data with no residency controls.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Credit card numbers stored and processed with no region constraints. Agent sending this data to an LLM provider in another jurisdiction would violate PCI-DSS.

findings.title: No Pagination or Result Size Limits
findings.description: Index action returns all matching orders with no pagination, no LIMIT clause, no cursor support. Unbounded result sets.
findings.gap: No pagination. Agent queries could return unbounded result sets exceeding context windows.
findings.recommendation: Implement pagination with limit/offset or cursor-based navigation and result size caps.

findings.title: No Input Validation — SQL Injection and Mass Assignment
findings.description: No input validation. SQL injection via direct string interpolation in find_by_sql. Mass assignment via Order.new(params[:order]) with no attr_accessible.
findings.gap: No validation at any layer. SQL injection and mass assignment vulnerabilities.
findings.recommendation: Fix SQL injection with parameterized queries. Add attr_accessible. Implement request validation.

findings.title: Minimal Temporal Metadata
findings.description: created_at field exists (referenced in ORDER BY). No updated_at evidence, no timezone normalization, no freshness signaling to callers.
findings.gap: Minimal temporal metadata. No update tracking or freshness signaling.
findings.recommendation: Ensure created_at/updated_at exposed in responses. Add Cache-Control headers.

findings.title: No PII Redaction in Logs
findings.description: System processes credit card numbers. Rails 2.3 default logging logs request parameters including card data. No filter_parameter_logging, no PII masking.
findings.gap: No PII redaction. Credit card numbers likely appear in default Rails request logs.
findings.recommendation: Add filter_parameter_logging for sensitive fields. Implement log scrubbing middleware.

findings.title: No Data Quality Awareness
findings.description: No data quality metrics, completeness scoring, or null rate monitoring for the MySQL datastore.
findings.gap: No data quality awareness for the persistent data store.
findings.recommendation: Implement data quality monitoring for critical fields after modernization.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No versioned URLs, no Accept-Version headers, no changelog, no database migrations, no breaking change detection, no contract tests.
findings.gap: Agent tool bindings could break silently on any deployment.
findings.recommendation: Implement URL-based API versioning and breaking change detection in CI.

findings.title: Semantically Clear Field Names
findings.description: Visible field names are semantically meaningful: status, created_at, card_number, card_exp, total. No legacy abbreviations evident.
findings.gap: Full schema not visible but observed fields are agent-friendly.
findings.recommendation: Maintain clear naming conventions during modernization.

findings.title: No Data Catalog or Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog, no schema documentation, no metadata layer. Schema known only from code inspection.
findings.gap: No centralized metadata describing available data and its semantics.
findings.recommendation: Create data dictionary documenting orders table schema during modernization.

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No OpenTelemetry, no X-Ray, no trace ID propagation. No structured logging — Rails 2.3 uses unstructured text logs. No correlation IDs.
findings.gap: Agent-initiated request failures not debuggable.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured JSON logging with correlation IDs and distributed tracing.

findings.title: No Alerting on Error Rates or Latency
findings.description: No alerting configuration. No CloudWatch alarms, no anomaly detection, no monitoring.
findings.gap: System degradation undetectable until agent failures cascade.
findings.recommendation: Implement CloudWatch alarms on error rates and latency for all endpoints.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No IaC. Manual EC2 management via Capistrano 2 to fixed hosts. No Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK.
findings.gap: No infrastructure governance. Manual error-prone changes. No drift detection.
findings.recommendation: Define all infrastructure as IaC using Terraform or CloudFormation with PR-based review.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline. Manual Capistrano deployment. No contract testing, no automated testing in pipeline.
findings.gap: No automated testing or contract validation. Changes deployed without verification.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with automated testing and API contract validation.

findings.title: Limited Rollback Capability
findings.description: Capistrano 2 provides basic code rollback. No automated triggers, no database rollback, no traffic shifting, no canary deployments.
findings.gap: Rollback limited to Capistrano code revert. No automated rollback triggers.
findings.recommendation: Implement blue/green deployment with automated rollback triggers on error rate metrics.

findings.title: No API Test Coverage
findings.description: Stale Test::Unit suite that no longer runs. No test files present. No API tests, integration tests, or contract tests.
findings.gap: No working test coverage. Agent-facing behavior changes unverifiable.
findings.recommendation: Create automated API test suite covering order operations. Run in CI.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: MySQL 5.1 on EC2 with no encryption at rest. Credit card data stored unencrypted. No KMS, no encrypted EBS volumes.
findings.gap: No encryption at rest for PCI-regulated card data.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to RDS with KMS encryption at rest. Encrypt EBS volumes.

evaluations.title: Business Outcome Metrics
evaluations.reason: No metrics or telemetry surface exists to assess — informational signal, no finding emitted.

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — service is not P0 priority and no priority was provided.

items.summary: Resolve all 7 BLOCKERs and critical RISK-SAFETY findings. Establish authentication, audit logging, data protection, and idempotency before any agent integration.
Address RISK-QUALITY findings to improve agent effectiveness. Implement observability, IaC, CI/CD, and proper data handling.
Address INFO and low-priority quality findings. Add event emission, rate limit headers, data catalog, and test coverage.

recommended_actions.rationale: Foundation for all security controls. Without authentication, no other security mechanism can function.

recommended_actions.action: Migrate credentials to secrets management and rotate
recommended_actions.rationale: Live credentials in source control represent immediate security exposure.
Credit card data exposed in API responses and stored unencrypted violates PCI-DSS.
Write operations that duplicate on retry create financial risk at machine speed.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy API Gateway with rate limiting and audit logging
recommended_actions.rationale: Provides audit trail, rate limiting, and blast radius protection in a single deployment.

recommended_actions.action: Modernize infrastructure with IaC and CI/CD
recommended_actions.rationale: Manual infrastructure and deployment prevent safe, repeatable changes.
